name: Lille
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the greater Lille metropolitan area / Metropole Europeenne de Lille (France), from Lille-Lesquin airport to the Belgian border at Mouscron. 356k+ OSM buildings (binary format), 622k+ commuters with demand built from real INSEE census data, including a synthetic cross-border commuting model for Mouscron (Belgium). Lille-Lesquin airport with runways and taxiways. Protomaps basemap with water, parks and forests.
data_source: INSEE Filosofi 2021 (donnees carroyees, revenus et population) - INSEE Recensement de la population 2021, mobilites professionnelles - OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) - Overture Maps Foundation (buildings)
